title: PandaOverhaul
description: Make Your Textures Simple And Stylish With The Theme Of Pandas!
body:
**This Texture Pack Is Inspired By Pandas** And It Adds A Lot Of Item, Mob and GUI Retextures.It Is Made In The Style Of Barebones And The Minecraft Jungle, Also Recommended To Use Another Testure Pack Of Mine With It Called PvP Planks [PvP Planks](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pvp-planks)
